card.name: Etymology phrases and digits in codes
card.fires_on: Words in 'named for the name of' or 'derived from' origin statements for elements and places. Also single digits inside long reference numbers, such as ZIP+4 codes, report numbers and URLs.

modes.label: Name-origin wording
modes.description: Small words such as the, name or from inside statements about where an element or place got its name.
modes.example: Cobalt derived its name<< from>> German miners.

modes.label: Digits in reference codes
modes.description: A single digit partway through a ZIP+4 code, report number, DOI or URL date string.
